links.outcome: Local ambient scribe assessment of accuracy (semantic agreement), usability, clinician experience, time savings
links.effect: Semantic agreement 87.4-89.2%; consultation duration 15.01 vs 14.65 min; clinician experience improved in five of seven domains (g = 0.25-0.41)
links.quote: Semantic agreement remained high and stable (87.4-89.2%).

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world deployment of an ambient AI scribe across 2.3 million outpatient visits, measuring clinician experience, semantic agreement, and consultation duration, but does not compare or test specific guardrails or deployment practices.
